index.title: Home

hero.title: Nuxt + Strapi, ready for production
hero.description: Server-side rendered Nuxt 4 front end with a headless Strapi 5 CMS, PrimeVue components, Tailwind CSS, localisation with RTL support, error monitoring and a complete test and CI setup.

about.title: About
body: This project is a starting point for content-driven websites: Nuxt renders pages on the server while Strapi provides a headless CMS for editors.

It focuses on the boring-but-important parts — typed data fetching, graceful failure when the CMS is unavailable, localisation, accessibility, monitoring and automated checks — so you can start building features straight away.

contact.title: Contact
body: Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue or a pull request on GitHub.
